name: Selenium CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '25'

      - name: Run Selenium Tests
        run: mvn clean install -DsuiteXmlFile=FunctionalTest_Suite.xml test
